question: Which of the following city hosted the 2022 Commonwealth games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Birmingham.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Commonwealth Games **is an** international multi-sport event** that is held **every four years.**
 
• The** 2022 edition** of the games was awarded to **Birmingham, England.**
 
• **Glasgow** hosted the **2014 Commonwealth Games**, while **Delhi **hosted the **2010 Commonwealth Games**.
 
• **Gold Coast **hosted the most recent edition of the games in** 2018.**
 
• Birmingham was awarded the hosting rights for the **2022 Commonwealth Games** in **December 2017**, beating out rival bids from **Liverpool and Kuala Lumpur.**
 
• The **2022 Commonwealth Games** were originally scheduled to be held in **Durban, South Africa**, but the city was stripped of the hosting rights in **2017** due to financial and logistical problems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Glasgow** hosted the 2014 Commonwealth Games in **Scotland.**

 
 
• The games featured ove**r 4,900 athletes **from **71 countries** competing in **17 sports.**
 
 
 
• **Delhi** hosted the 2010 Commonwealth Games in India.
 
 
• The games were marred by **controversy and criticism **over infrastructure issues, security concerns, and allegations of corruption.
 
 
 
• **Gold Coast **hosted the 2018 Commonwealth Games in **Australia**.
 
 
• The games featured over **6,600 athletes **from **71 countries **competing in **18 sports.**
 
• The** Australian **team topped the medal table with **80 gold medals.**
